Bronzehead arrow

Internal ID: ArrowBronze | Type: Arrow | Source: Forge | Usage: Bow ammunition | Crafting Materials: Wood x8, Bronze x1, Feathers x2

Introduction. Bronzehead arrows are ammunition for bows and are the next direct upgrade from flinthead arrows.

Availability. • Bronzehead arrows can be crafted at the forge once bronze is collected.
